issues.description: Packetization logic is complected with serialization and transport in _write_frame
issues.detail: The transport's send path now conflates three concerns: serializer output, audio-vs-control discrimination, and fixed-size repacketization. A buffer that only makes sense for raw PCM lives inside a generic send method that also handles JSON commands. Decompose: a pure function chunk(buffer, size) -> (chunks, remainder) plus an explicit AudioPayload value would separate framing from transport.

issues.description: Control vs audio payloads are distinguished by isinstance(bytes) — type is overloaded with meaning
issues.detail: The serializer returns str|bytes|None where bytes means audio and str means control JSON. The transport then re-derives that meaning by checking isinstance. Two layers each reinvent the same implicit contract. A small tagged value (AudioBytes vs ControlText) would make the time and identity of each payload explicit and remove the place-oriented type-sniffing.

issues.description: Mutable bytearray buffer is place-oriented state hidden inside the transport
issues.detail: _audio_send_buffer is a mutating place whose lifetime, ownership, and interaction with InterruptionFrame are now load-bearing but implicit. The clear-on-interrupt logic is correct today, but any future caller emitting partial PCM through a different path will silently desync. Pushing the buffer into a small Packetizer value with explicit feed/drain/reset would make the identity and time semantics legible.

issues.description: DTMF digit extraction guesses at two shapes of an undocumented event
issues.detail: `message.get("digit") or message.get("dtmf", {}).get("digit")` encodes uncertainty about Vonage's actual schema as runtime fallback. That is incidental complexity from not knowing the fact. Either confirm the protocol (one shape) and delete the other branch, or log the unknown shape loudly so the assumption surfaces rather than silently working.

issues.description: Resampler return-value is checked with two different sentinels meaning the same thing
issues.detail: `if serialized_data is None or len(serialized_data) == 0` appears twice. Two ways to say "no audio" complect API uncertainty with handling. Pick one contract from create_stream_resampler (never None, or always None on empty) and normalize at the boundary so call sites carry a single value semantics.

issues.description: Rename from audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is easy-not-simple
issues.detail: Renaming a public field is a breaking change disguised as clarification. The changelog mentions it but there is no deprecation alias. Either keep it a true rename with a migration note prominent in the upgrade path, or accept the old name with a deprecation warning for one release. The current shape optimizes for the new reader at the cost of every existing caller.

review.summary: The Vonage serializer and the FastAPI transport changes are reasonable working code, but they entangle several concerns that want to live apart: serialization, audio-vs-control discrimination, and fixed-size repacketization all collapse into _write_frame, and a mutable bytearray now carries load-bearing state with implicit lifetime rules. The serializer overloads str|bytes as a tag for control vs audio, and the transport re-derives that tag by isinstance. None of this is wrong today; it is easy, not simple. A small Packetizer value plus tagged payloads would make values, identity, and time explicit and remove the incidental coupling. The DTMF shape-guessing and dual empty-sentinel checks are smaller incidental-complexity items worth cleaning while the code is fresh.
